title: Roke Sakina Kehti Thi
body:
MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI.... (2)
Mere bhai dil behlate thai
Mere ammu naaz  utha te thai (2)
Jab unki yaad sataegi (2)
Ankhon se  ashq bahaongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Mein tham ke jhule ki dori
bhai ko sunati thi lori(2)
Afsos mera asghar na raha(2)
Mein kaise  dil bhelaongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Gham qasim ka gham Akbar ka
Gham aun o Muhammed asghar ka (2)
Yaad apnon ki tadpayegi (2)
Kis kis ka dard  bhulaongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Seene pa tumhare har  lamha
Mein chain se soti thi baba (2)
Sona  ke liye tera seena(2)
Zindan mein kahan se Laongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Socho kya hoga haal mera
Baba na mila gar pyaar tera (2)
Mein zindan ki tariki mein (2)
Diwaron se takraongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Ahmad ke paak nawase par
Umaat ne  phair diya khanjar (2)
Har mood pa matam kar kar ke (2)
Mein baat yahi dahraongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Tha lab pa sakina ke noha
Mehsoos ye hota hai baba (2)
Tere  baad jiongi jab tak mein (2)
Zalim ke tamache khaongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Chehre pa daag tamachon ke
Hai khoon rawan mere khanon se (2)
Ab paas  bula lo aey  baba(2)
Mein apne dard  sunaongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI... (2)
Jawwad o Shozab boli dukhi
Zindan banega lahed meri (2)
Turbat mein bhi Teri gurbat ka (2)
Mein baba sogh manaongi...
ROKE SAKINA KEHTI THI MEIN KUFA SHAAM NA JAONGI..... (2)
